setup: Deal two to each player. Keep one and return the other unseen.

objectives.name: Quietly Indispensable
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 2 powered Facilities and no more than 4 Scrutiny cubes in the bag.
objectives.flavorText: Nobody knows what the institution does. Every institution depends on it.
objectives.artDirection: An unmarked facility connected by glowing lines to every visible district.

objectives.name: Too Big to Pause
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 3 Customers and Trust of 3 or less.
objectives.flavorText: Public confidence is temporary. Integration contracts are forever.
objectives.artDirection: A warning lever enclosed behind customer logos and legal injunctions.

objectives.name: Benevolent Monopoly
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 3 Customers and at least 4 Trust.
objectives.flavorText: Everyone selected the default because the default selected everyone.
objectives.artDirection: A friendly universal assistant hovering above a city with no visible alternatives.

objectives.name: Institutional Capture
objectives.rulesText: At game end, control at least 2 of Media, Government, and Capital.
objectives.flavorText: The ecosystem has matured into a single calendar invitation.
objectives.artDirection: Three monumental buildings connected to one discreet conference room.

objectives.name: Distributed Denial of Scarcity
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have 2 adjacent Facilities in your Network and at least 1 Generator.
objectives.flavorText: There is more than enough capacity, provided every request is strategically important.
objectives.artDirection: A power network blazing at full capacity while a polite queue extends beyond the frame.

objectives.name: Paper AGI
objectives.rulesText: Declare AGI while having exactly 2 Facilities.
objectives.flavorText: The infrastructure is minimal because intelligence has become capital-efficient.
objectives.artDirection: Three compact buildings casting the shadow of an impossible machine.

objectives.name: The Industrial Sublime
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have 3 Facilities, 1 Generator, and both Link tokens installed.
objectives.flavorText: At dusk, the cooling towers appear almost constitutional.
objectives.artDirection: A monumental powered campus painted like a state portrait.

objectives.name: Public Option, Private Invoice
objectives.rulesText: At game end, control Government or Capital and have at least 6 Runway.
objectives.flavorText: The service is universal. The margin is also universal.
objectives.artDirection: A public-service kiosk dispensing receipts into a private armored vehicle.

objectives.name: The Open, Closed Loop
objectives.rulesText: Use Open Weights and finish the game with more Capability than every player who had less Capability when you used it.
objectives.flavorText: The ecosystem is open. The lead is proprietary.
objectives.artDirection: Open model weights flowing outward and returning as a locked golden circuit.

objectives.name: Alignment as a Service
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 4 Trust and have completed a Joint Venture.
objectives.flavorText: Values are now available through the enterprise plan.
objectives.artDirection: Two institutions connecting moral compasses through a subscription terminal.

objectives.name: Everyone Is a Customer Eventually
objectives.rulesText: Deploy at least once in two different rounds.
objectives.flavorText: Adoption is merely consent viewed over a sufficiently long horizon.
objectives.artDirection: A product funnel widening until it encloses an entire city.

objectives.name: Regulatory Moat
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 1 Policy Shield and control Government.
objectives.flavorText: Compliance is expensive, which is why nobody else should be permitted to attempt it.
objectives.artDirection: A fortress built from policy binders surrounding a polished data center.

objectives.name: Recursive Revenue
objectives.rulesText: During one Production, gain Runway from Customers, a Facility, a Network, and a Joint Venture.
objectives.flavorText: Every part of the institution now invoices another part.
objectives.artDirection: A circular corporate diagram made entirely of invoices and glowing arrows.

objectives.name: Compute Diplomacy
objectives.rulesText: Buy or sell at least 1 Power through an immediate Production trade.
objectives.flavorText: Peace is what happens when everyone has a shared cooling dependency.
objectives.artDirection: Three rival compounds exchanging electricity across a tense ceremonial border.

objectives.name: Credible Denial
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 8 Capability and no more than 1 Customer.
objectives.flavorText: The model is not deployed. It is merely answering production traffic.
objectives.artDirection: A sealed research vault with millions of cables quietly leaving through the floor.

objectives.name: History Will Call It Necessary
objectives.rulesText: At game end, have at least 6 Scrutiny added across the game and at least 4 Trust.
objectives.flavorText: The controversy has been successfully converted into institutional memory.
objectives.artDirection: A museum exhibit honoring a smoking machine while visitors listen respectfully.

objectives.name: The Fusion Press Cycle
objectives.rulesText: Construct the Fusion Demonstrator and Declare AGI in Round IV.
objectives.flavorText: Two announcements are more scientific than one.
objectives.artDirection: A fusion chamber and AGI podium sharing a single countdown clock.

objectives.name: A Perfectly Normal Quarter
objectives.rulesText: Use Wild Actions in at least 2 different rounds.
objectives.flavorText: Operations remained within parameters after the parameters were expanded.
objectives.artDirection: Three increasingly impossible quarterly reports arranged with identical sober typography.
